mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (title, description, category, instructor_id, instructor_name, created_date, updated_date, status, enrollment_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{instructorId}, #{instructorName}, NOW(), NOW(), #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, category, instructor_id as instructorId, instructor_name as instructorName, created_date as createdDate, updated_date as updatedDate, status, enrollment_count as enrollmentCount FROM courses WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, title, description, category, instructor_id as instructorId, instructor_name as instructorName, created_date as createdDate, updated_date as updatedDate, status, enrollment_count as enrollmentCount FROM courses ORDER BY created_date DESC

SELECT id, title, description, category, instructor_id as instructorId, instructor_name as instructorName, created_date as createdDate, updated_date as updatedDate, status, enrollment_count as enrollmentCount FROM courses WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY created_date DESC

SELECT id, title, description, category, instructor_id as instructorId, instructor_name as instructorName, created_date as createdDate, updated_date as updatedDate, status, enrollment_count as enrollmentCount FROM courses WHERE instructor_id = #{instructorId} ORDER BY created_date DESC

SELECT id, title, description, category, instructor_id as instructorId, instructor_name as instructorName, created_date as createdDate, updated_date as updatedDate, status, enrollment_count as enrollmentCount FROM courses WHERE (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY created_date DESC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM courses WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY category
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
